entries.measurementMethod: Manual inspection of generated source, 3x coordinate-grid crops and 8–10x endpoint closeups; ground points use facade baseline or fence-post foot, not alpha bounds or expected registration
entries.personnelDoorNotes: 16x review: edited green mark at x173,y306–315 has visible brick wall continuing down to the facade baseline near y324; it is a raised window rather than an observable ground-reaching door. Remaining visible openings are broad bays.
entries.reviewNotes: Door-only edited source reviewed directly; earlier approximate narrow-door interpretation withdrawn because it did not establish a physical ground-reaching doorway.

physicalSheetDensity.note: Actual observed dairy pasture fence-post feet delimit this clear whole-parcel side. Assigning it75m is explicitly the planned envelope design assumption. The industrial compounds have staggered/irregular pavement boundaries, so no200px whole-plot industrial side has been invented. Oversized fences are excluded from final farm art acceptance; the ground-side pixel density is still observable and can calibrate one common density for all sheet cells.

sheetScaleCalibration.policy: One explicitly measured source-pixel density for the whole sheet; no automatic alpha/silhouette fitting and no per-entry scale

sourceIsolationNoise.method: Original sheet alpha outside the union of explicit occupied-slot crop rectangles

mipFilter: Independent original-cutout premultiplied-alpha Lanczos affine; no sharpening
groundKey: RGBA alpha, bare ground must be authored transparent; no colour keying
